invariants.rationale: Typically, the number of output partitions should be positive for repartitioning to make sense.
The input records list should not be null for processing.
The size of a list is always non-negative.
If outputPartitions exceeds the list size, the input might be empty; otherwise, we cannot repartition into more partitions than there are records.
All elements in the records list should be non-null for sorting and processing.
